verdict.rationale: incident.io documents a postmortem workflow: AI-generated first drafts, inline review suggestions and section redrafting, plus org-wide completion tracking through list views, the post-incident flow and policies. The auto-generated timeline exists but is never explicitly tied to postmortem drafting, and templates and publication are not evidenced; status-page publishing is a different feature. missing for 10: postmortem templates, explicit drafting from the incident timeline, a human review/approval workflow, postmortem publication/sharing, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering leader, postmortems follow a real workflow — templates, drafting from the timeline, review, and publication
